title: Everything you need to know to buy a house in in the Killeen/Temple Texas area! | PCS to FORT HOOD
description:
Get your copy of the buyers guide: https://shorturl.at/kSLNp 
(Download PDF for best viewing, Google drive takes a while to populate fully) 

My goal in making this video is so that you are able to make EDUCATED and informed decisions as you prepare to buy a house in the Fort Hood Texas area! 
Whether you are looking in Killeen, Temple, Belton, Harker Heights, Salado or anywhere really from Waco to Austin, this guide WILL HELP YOU!

If you are PCSing, relocating for work, or just moving here because the cost of living is really good compared to other parts of Texas, you are in the right spot!

My name is Samantha Hammonds, Jesus Loving & Bible-believing, Wife, mom, and REALTOR® I love helping my clients truly understand the real estate process and I make it my goal to make the process smooth and simple for them! I want to dispel the myth that homeownership is unattainable for the average person! YOU CAN be a homeowner to and begin to build a legacy through generational wealth and creating a life giving home!

If you are looking to buy or sell anywhere in the USA reach out to me. 

I personally service the Central Texas Market area, (Fort Hood and surrounding areas) but I would love to help you by referring you to a partner anywhere in the USA if you need help in an area I do not service myself! 

Brokered by: Realty Of America (ROA)
